letters.name: A (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like the 'a' in 'father' — open your mouth wide and say 'ah' at the doctor. あ looks a bit like someone stretching their arms wide open.

letters.name: I (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like the 'ee' in 'see' — a clean, short vowel. The two strokes of い look like two little eyes, and 'i' (eye) is exactly how you pronounce it.

letters.name: U (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like the 'oo' in 'boot' but without rounding your lips much — keep them relaxed. う looks a bit like a little sideways smile or a cup.

letters.name: E (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like the 'e' in 'bed' — short and crisp. え looks a little like a person doing a little dance. Think of saying 'eh?' when you see something curious.

letters.name: O (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like the 'o' in 'go' — round and clear. お has a little loop and a stroke; think of an Olympic ring — 'O!'

letters.name: Ka (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ka' in 'karate' — crisp and short. か looks like the hilt and blade of a katana — just add one more stroke and it's a sword!

letters.name: Ki (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'key' in English — same sound! き looks like an old-fashioned skeleton key with its curved top and straight shaft.

letters.name: Ku (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'coo' as in a dove cooing. く is just one angled stroke — think of a cuckoo bird opening its beak to say 'kuu!'

letters.name: Ke (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ke' in 'kettle' — short and snappy. け looks a bit like a person kicking a ball — 'ke!' as they make contact.

letters.name: Ko (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'co' in 'cocoa' — warm and round. こ is just two little strokes; think of a child's toy top spinning — 'ko!'

letters.name: Sa (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'sa' in 'salsa' — crisp. さ looks like a little sail on a boat — 'sa!' as the wind catches it.

letters.name: Shi (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'she' in English — exactly the same sound! し is a single curving stroke; think of a little fish hook or a strand of hair curling down.

letters.name: Su (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'sue' but shorter — as in 'Susan' with the 'an' chopped off. す has a little loop like a curl of steam rising from soup — 'su!' as you slurp.

letters.name: Se (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'se' in 'set' — short and clear. せ looks like a face in profile with a little nose — 'say' hello with your face!

letters.name: So (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'so' in 'sofa' — round and easy. そ looks like a zigzag path; think of walking 'so far' along a winding road.

letters.name: Ta (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ta' in 'taco' — bright and crisp. た looks like the letters 'ta' squished together into one character!

letters.name: Chi (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'chee' in 'cheese' — say it with a big grin! ち looks a bit like a cheeky smile or a person tipping their hat.

letters.name: Tsu (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'tsu' in 'tsunami' — a quick 't' followed by 'sue'. つ is a single curling stroke like a little wave; think of a tsu-nami wave curling over.

letters.name: Te (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'te' in 'tennis' — light and quick. て looks like the curve of a tennis racket — 'te!' as the ball bounces off.

letters.name: To (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'toe' in English — almost identical! と is just two short strokes; think of a toe poking out of a sock.

letters.name: Na (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'na' in 'nachos' — warm and open. な looks like a little knot being tied — think of tying a knot and saying 'na!' when it's done.

letters.name: Ni (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'knee' in English — same sound! に looks a bit like a bent knee, which makes it easy to remember.

letters.name: Nu (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'noo' in 'noodle' but shorter. ぬ looks like a twisted noodle on a fork — 'nu' as you slurp it up!

letters.name: Ne (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ne' in 'net' — short and clear. ね looks like a curled-up cat sleeping — and 'neko' (cat) starts with ね!

letters.name: No (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'no' in English — same sound! の looks like a simple loop, and it's the possessive particle ('s). Think of a 'No' symbol with a loop through it.

letters.name: Ha (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ha' in 'haha' (laughter) — a bright, breathy sound. は looks like a person laughing with arms out — 'ha ha!' Note: when used as the topic particle, は is pronounced 'wa'.

letters.name: Hi (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'hee' in 'heel' but with a breathier 'h'. ひ is a single graceful stroke that looks like a smile; think of saying 'hee hee!' with a big grin.

letters.name: Fu (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Between 'foo' and 'who' — blow gently like blowing out a candle. ふ looks like a little puff of breath with a curl at the top.

letters.name: He (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'he' in 'hen' — short and light. へ is a simple mountain shape; think of climbing a hill and breathing 'heh!' at the top. Note: when used as the direction particle, へ is pronounced 'e'.

letters.name: Ho (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ho' in 'hope' — warm and open. ほ has a cross on top; think of a 'ho'-ly symbol or a star shining hope.

letters.name: Ma (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ma' in 'mama' — warm and familiar. ま looks like a little face with two eyes and a smile; think of your mama's smiling face.

letters.name: Mi (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'me' in English — same sound! み has a loop with a tail; think of someone saying 'me me me!' and pointing at themselves.

letters.name: Mu (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'moo' as a cow says — but shorter and without rounding your lips as much. む looks like a little cow face with a curl on top — 'muu!'

letters.name: Me (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'me' in 'melon' — short and clear. め is the word for 'eye' in Japanese; the little loop in め looks just like an eye!

letters.name: Mo (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'mo' in 'more' — round and open. も looks like a little fish with two strokes; think of wanting 'mo'-re fish!

letters.name: Ya (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ya' in 'yacht' — bright and quick. や looks like a little sail; think of a yacht sailing away — 'ya!'

letters.name: Yu (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'you' in English — same sound! ゆ looks like a little fish swimming sideways; think of saying 'you!' to a fish in a tank.

letters.name: Yo (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'yo' in 'yo-yo' — snappy and energetic. よ has a little hook at the bottom; think of a yo-yo dropping down — 'yo!'

letters.name: Ra (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Between English 'ra' and 'la' — a quick tap of the tongue, like the 'tt' in American 'butter'. ら looks like a person sitting down; think of relaxing — 'ra!'

letters.name: Ri (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Between English 'ree' and 'lee' — a quick tongue tap. り is just two strokes; it looks like two little reeds swaying by a river — 'ri!'

letters.name: Ru (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Between English 'roo' and 'loo' — a quick tap followed by a relaxed 'oo'. る has a little loop at the bottom like a curled-up rope — think of a 'roo'-led-up cord.

letters.name: Re (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Between English 're' and 'le' — like the 're' in 'red' with a tongue tap. れ has a distinctive zigzag; think of a little lightning bolt striking — 're!' as in electric.

letters.name: Ro (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Between English 'ro' and 'lo' — like 'row' a boat but with a tongue tap. ろ looks like the number 3 with a roof; think of 'ro'-wing a boat along the river.

letters.name: Wa (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'wa' in 'water' — round and smooth. わ looks like a little whirlpool; think of 'wa'-ter swirling around in a whirlpool.

letters.name: Wo / O (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Pronounced exactly like お ('o') in modern Japanese — it's the direct object marker particle. Think of pointing at an object and saying 'Oh!'. Words do not begin with を in modern Japanese; it appears only as a grammar particle.

letters.name: N (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: A standalone nasal 'n' — like the 'n' in 'song' or 'm' depending on what follows. ん is the only kana that cannot start a word. It looks like a little 'n' shape with a tail.

letters.name: Ga (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ga' in 'garden' — a voiced か (ka). The two little marks (dakuten) turn a crisp 'k' into a humming 'g'. Think of gargling with your voice on!

letters.name: Gi (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'gi' in 'guitar' — a voiced き (ki). The dakuten marks add buzz to 'ki' to make it 'gi'. Think of a guitar string vibrating — 'gi!'

letters.name: Gu (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'goo' in 'good' — a voiced く (ku). Add voice to the cuckoo's 'ku' and you get a happy 'guu!'

letters.name: Ge (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ge' in 'get' — a voiced け (ke). The person kicking in け now has heavy boots on — 'ge!'

letters.name: Go (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'go' in English — same sound! ご is こ (ko) with dakuten. The child's spinning top now has a motor — 'go go go!'

letters.name: Za (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'za' in 'pizza' — a buzzy, voiced さ (sa). The sailboat now has a buzzing motor — 'za!' as it zips across the water.

letters.name: Ji (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'jee' in 'jeep' — a voiced し (shi). The little fish hook now has a buzzy engine attached. Think of a jeep driving by — 'ji!'

letters.name: Zu (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'zoo' — a voiced す (su). The steam from the soup now has a buzz; think of visiting the zoo — 'zu!'

letters.name: Ze (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ze' in 'zebra' — a voiced せ (se). The face in profile is now buzzing with excitement — 'ze!'

letters.name: Zo (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'zo' in 'zone' — a voiced そ (so). The zigzag path now leads to a buzzing zone — 'zo!' as you enter.

letters.name: Da (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'da' in 'dance' — a voiced た (ta). The 'ta' character now has a deeper, warmer sound. Think of a drum beat — 'da!'

letters.name: Dji / Ji (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Pronounced the same as じ (ji) in modern Japanese — like 'jee' in 'jeep'. ぢ is very rare and appears mainly in compound words like はなぢ (nosebleed). Think of it as ち putting on a buzzing voice mask.

letters.name: Dzu / Zu (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Pronounced the same as ず (zu) in modern Japanese — like 'zoo'. づ is rare and appears mainly in compound words. Think of つ putting on a buzzing voice.

letters.name: De (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'de' in 'desk' — a voiced て (te). The tennis ball now has weight behind it. で is also the location/tool particle ('at', 'by', 'using').

letters.name: Do (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'do' in 'dough' — a voiced と (to). The toe now taps the floor with a weighty 'do!'. Think of a deep drum beat.

letters.name: Ba (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ba' in 'balloon' — a voiced は (ha). The laughing 'ha ha' now has a deep belly laugh — 'ba!' Think of a baby learning to talk.

letters.name: Bi (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'bee' — a voiced ひ (hi). The smiling 'hee' now buzzes like a bee — 'bi!' Think of a busy bee going about its day.

letters.name: Bu (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'boo' in 'boot' — a voiced ふ (fu). The gentle puff of air now becomes a solid 'boo!' Think of someone saying 'boo!' to surprise you.

letters.name: Be (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'be' in 'bed' — a voiced へ (he). The mountain now has a base camp — 'be!' Think of going to bed at base camp after a long climb.

letters.name: Bo (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'bo' in 'boat' — a voiced ほ (ho). The starry hope now has a deep, resonant glow — think of a boat sailing under the stars.

letters.name: Pa (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'pa' in 'papa' — a crisp, popping は (ha) with a little circle (handakuten). The laugh now has a pop to it — think of popping a bubble: 'pa!'

letters.name: Pi (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'pea' — a crisp, popping ひ (hi) with handakuten. The smile now has a little pop — think of popping peas out of a pod: 'pi!'

letters.name: Pu (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'poo' but shorter — a crisp, popping ふ (fu) with handakuten. The puff of air now pops — think of a little bubble going 'pu!'

letters.name: Pe (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'pe' in 'pen' — a crisp, popping へ (he) with handakuten. The mountain now has a peak — 'pe!' as you reach the top.

letters.name: Po (Hiragana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'po' in 'popcorn' — a crisp, popping ほ (ho) with handakuten. The hope-filled star now goes 'pop!' Think of popcorn popping — 'po po po!'

letters.name: Kya (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: A small や (ya) attaches to き (ki) to make 'kya' — like 'kya' as a surprised shriek! The small や is how Japanese packs two sounds into one beat.

letters.name: Kyu (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: A small ゆ (yu) attaches to き (ki) to make 'kyu' — like the 'cu' in 'cute' but shorter. Think of something being so cute you say 'kyu!'

letters.name: Kyo (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: A small よ (yo) attaches to き (ki) to make 'kyo' — like the 'kyo' in 'Tokyo'! Think of the famous city and you've got it.

letters.name: Gya (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small や on ぎ (gi) — like 'gya' as a buzzy shriek. The dakuten adds voice to きゃ (kya). Think of a guitar going 'gya-ng!'

letters.name: Gyu (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ゆ on ぎ (gi) — like the 'gu' in 'argue' but with a 'y' glide. Think of squeezing something tight — 'gyu!'

letters.name: Gyo (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small よ on ぎ (gi) — like 'gyo' as in 'gyoza'! Think of the delicious dumplings and you'll never forget this sound.

letters.name: Sha (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small や on し (shi) — like 'sha' in 'shawl'! Think of wrapping a warm shawl around your shoulders — 'sha!'

letters.name: Shu (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ゆ on し (shi) — like 'shoe' in English! Think of putting on your shoes — 'shu!' as you slide them on.

letters.name: Sho (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small よ on し (shi) — like 'show' in English! Think of a spectacular show — 'sho!' as the curtain rises.

letters.name: Ja (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small や on じ (ji) — like 'ja' in 'jazz'! Think of a jazz musician going 'ja-zz!' — しゃ with dakuten adds the buzz.

letters.name: Ju (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ゆ on じ (ji) — like 'joo' in 'juice'! Think of squeezing fresh juice — 'ju!' — しゅ with dakuten adds the buzz.

letters.name: Jo (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small よ on じ (ji) — like 'jo' in 'joke'! Think of telling a funny joke — 'jo!' — しょ with dakuten adds the buzz.

letters.name: Cha (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small や on ち (chi) — like 'cha' in 'chocolate'! Think of a warm cup of おちゃ (tea) — 'cha' in Japanese means tea!

letters.name: Chu (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ゆ on ち (chi) — like 'chew' in English! Think of a little mouse going 'chu chu!' as it nibbles on cheese.

letters.name: Cho (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small よ on ち (chi) — like 'cho' in 'chocolate'! Think of a butterfly (ちょう) fluttering by — 'cho!' as it lands on a flower.

letters.name: Nya (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small や on に (ni) — like 'nya' as in the sound a cat makes! The Japanese cat says にゃー (nyaa) — perfect for remembering this one.

letters.name: Nyu (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ゆ on に (ni) — like 'new' in English! Think of getting something brand new — 'nyu!' as you unwrap it.

letters.name: Nyo (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small よ on に (ni) — like 'nyo' — not common in English, but think of the sound Pinocchio might make if his nose grew — 'nyo!'

letters.name: Hya (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small や on ひ (hi) — like 'hya' as a breathy laugh! Think of someone going 'hya hya!' with a wheezy giggle.

letters.name: Hyu (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ゆ on ひ (hi) — like 'hyoo' but breathier. Think of a cool breeze going 'hyu~' as it whistles past.

letters.name: Hyo (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small よ on ひ (hi) — like 'hyo' as a surprised little gasp! Think of something unexpected making you go 'hyo!'

letters.name: Bya (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small や on び (bi) — like 'bya' with a buzzy voice. ひゃ with dakuten adds the buzz. Think of a bee going 'bya!' as it flies by.

letters.name: Byu (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ゆ on び (bi) — like 'byoo' with a buzzy voice. Think of a viewpoint ('byuu') — a way of seeing things.

letters.name: Byo (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small よ on び (bi) — like 'byo' as in hospital (びょういん). Think of going to the hospital — 'byo!' for your checkup.

letters.name: Pya (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small や on ぴ (pi) — a popping 'pya'! Think of a cartoon character going 'pya!' when surprised. ひゃ with handakuten adds the pop.

letters.name: Pyu (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ゆ on ぴ (pi) — a popping 'pyu'! Think of a cork popping out of a bottle — 'pyu!' as it flies through the air.

letters.name: Pyo (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small よ on ぴ (pi) — a popping 'pyo'! Think of a little frog hopping — 'pyo pyo!' as it jumps from lily pad to lily pad.

letters.name: Mya (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small や on み (mi) — like 'mya' as a soft, warm sound. Think of a cozy cat purring 'mya~' while curled up in your lap.

letters.name: Myu (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ゆ on み (mi) — like 'mew' as in a kitten's sound! Think of a tiny kitten going 'myu!' for attention.

letters.name: Myo (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small よ on み (mi) — like 'myo' as a mysterious, soft sound. Think of something mysterious (みょう) happening — 'myo!' as you discover a secret.

letters.name: Rya (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small や on り (ri) — like 'rya' with that Japanese tongue-tap 'r'. Think of a brief, light tap — 'rya!' as you snap your fingers.

letters.name: Ryu (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ゆ on り (ri) — like 'ryu' as in 'ryu' (dragon)! Think of a dragon (りゅう) soaring through the sky — 'ryu!' with fiery breath.

letters.name: Ryo (Hiragana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small よ on り (ri) — like 'ryo' as in 'ryokan' (Japanese inn). Think of traveling (りょこう) — 'ryo!' as you set off on an adventure.

letters.name: A (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like the 'a' in 'father'. ア looks like an angular arrow pointing up and right — think of it as the corner of a building. Katakana is angular and sharp, like modern architecture!

letters.name: I (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like the 'ee' in 'see'. イ looks like a person standing tall — two straight strokes. Think of saying 'ee!' when you stand up straight.

letters.name: U (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'oo' in 'boot' but with relaxed lips. ウ looks like an angular container with a lid on top — think of a container going 'oo!' when you open it.

letters.name: E (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like the 'e' in 'bed'. エ is three straight lines — it looks like a capital 'I' with top and bottom bars. Think of an elevator door — 'e!' as it opens.

letters.name: O (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like the 'o' in 'go'. オ looks like a person with a hat on — think of someone tipping their hat and saying 'Oh!' in greeting.

letters.name: Ka (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ka' in 'karate'. カ looks like the blade of a sword — think of a karate chop! Just two angular strokes.

letters.name: Ki (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'key' in English. キ looks like a key with its three horizontal lines — the top and bottom lines are longer, like a key's teeth.

letters.name: Ku (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'coo' of a dove. ク is two angular strokes forming a corner — think of a cool corner of a building. It looks a bit like a sideways 'ku'.

letters.name: Ke (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ke' in 'kettle'. ケ looks like a little flag on a pole — think of a kettle steaming with a little flag waving 'ke!'

letters.name: Ko (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'co' in 'cocoa'. コ is a simple rectangular shape — think of a box of cocoa powder. Just two lines forming a right angle!

letters.name: Sa (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'sa' in 'salsa'. サ looks like a simplified face in profile — think of salsa dancing and saying 'sa!' as you twirl.

letters.name: Shi (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'she' in English. シ has three strokes that look like water droplets falling — think of a 'she'-et of rain. The strokes go downward-left, like tears.

letters.name: Su (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'sue' in 'Susan' but shorter. ス looks like a person running — think of someone in a suit running to catch a bus — 'su!'

letters.name: Se (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'se' in 'set'. セ looks like a mouth with a big grin — think of saying 'say cheese!' for a photo — 'se!' with a big smile.

letters.name: So (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'so' in 'sofa'. ソ has two strokes pointing downward-right — think of a soft sofa pillow with the corner folding down. Note: ソ (so) points down-right; ン (n) points down-left.

letters.name: Ta (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ta' in 'taco'. タ looks like a person doing a taco dance — one arm up, one leg out! Think of a tasty taco.

letters.name: Chi (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'chee' in 'cheese'. チ looks like a cross with a little tail — think of a piece of cheese on a toothpick. The strokes suggest 'cheese!'

letters.name: Tsu (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'tsu' in 'tsunami'. ツ has three strokes pointing downward-right — think of a 'tsu'-nami wave with droplets flying up. Note: ツ (tsu) points down-right; シ (shi) points more horizontal.

letters.name: Te (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'te' in 'tennis'. テ looks like a capital 'T' with an extra line — think of a tennis net with the posts on either side. 'Te!' as the ball goes over.

letters.name: To (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'toe' in English. ト looks like a toe pointing right — just two simple strokes. Think of stubbing your toe and going 'to!'

letters.name: Na (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'na' in 'nachos'. ナ looks like the letter 'na' squished together — just two strokes. Think of nachos with a big curve!

letters.name: Ni (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'knee' in English. ニ is just two parallel lines — literally the number 2 in Chinese/Japanese! Think of two knees — 'ni!' as you bend them.

letters.name: Nu (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'noo' in 'noodle' but shorter. ヌ looks like a person bending forward — think of a noodle bending over a bowl. Just two angular strokes.

letters.name: Ne (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ne' in 'net'. ネ looks like a cross on a stick — think of a net on a pole for catching butterflies. 'Ne!' as you scoop it up.

letters.name: No (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'no' in English. ノ is a single diagonal stroke — the simplest kana! Think of someone shaking their head 'no' — just a quick slash.

letters.name: Ha (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ha' in 'haha'. ハ looks exactly like the number 8 but with straight lines — think of laughing 'ha ha!' eight times. Simple two-stroke V-shape.

letters.name: Hi (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'hee' in 'heel'. ヒ looks like an old key or a sideways 'H' — think of saying 'hee!' as you unlock a door. Just two strokes.

letters.name: Fu (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Between 'foo' and 'who'. フ is a simple right-angle stroke — think of a puff of air going around a corner. Just one flowing stroke.

letters.name: He (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'he' in 'hen'. ヘ looks exactly like a mountain peak — identical to hiragana へ! Think of climbing a mountain and breathing 'heh!' at the top.

letters.name: Ho (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ho' in 'hope'. ホ looks like a cross with extra strokes — think of a holy symbol shining with hope. The cross with lines makes it easy to spot.

letters.name: Ma (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ma' in 'mama'. マ looks like a face in profile with a big nose — think of your mama's profile when she looks out the window.

letters.name: Mi (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'me' in English. ミ is three parallel lines sloping down — think of three musical notes going 'mi mi mi!' Like a little melody.

letters.name: Mu (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'moo' of a cow but shorter. ム looks like a triangle with a leg — think of a cow's face with one ear perked up — 'muu!'

letters.name: Me (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'me' in 'melon'. メ looks like an X mark — think of crossing something out and saying 'meh!' It's simple: just two diagonal strokes forming an X.

letters.name: Mo (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'mo' in 'more'. モ looks like a little building with a roof — think of wanting 'mo'-re buildings in your model city. Simple horizontal and vertical strokes.

letters.name: Ya (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ya' in 'yacht'. ヤ looks like a person waving with one arm raised — think of saying 'ya!' while waving hello. Two clean strokes.

letters.name: Yu (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'you' in English. ユ looks like a sideways 'U' with an extra line — think of pointing at someone and saying 'you!' Two strokes form a cup-like shape.

letters.name: Yo (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'yo' in 'yo-yo'. ヨ looks like a sideways 'E' — think of a yo-yo going up and down the three horizontal bars. 'Yo!' as it bounces.

letters.name: Ra (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Between English 'ra' and 'la' — a quick tongue tap. ラ looks like a person waving both arms — think of a cheerleader at a rally going 'ra ra ra!'

letters.name: Ri (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Between English 'ree' and 'lee'. リ is two vertical strokes — think of reeds growing straight up by a river. Simple, tall, and elegant.

letters.name: Ru (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Between English 'roo' and 'loo'. ル looks like a person bending down with legs apart — think of a kangaroo hopping — 'roo!' but with a Japanese tap.

letters.name: Re (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Between English 're' and 'le'. レ is a single stroke curling down-right — the most minimal kana! Think of a red line being drawn with one quick stroke — 're!'

letters.name: Ro (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Between English 'ro' and 'lo'. ロ is a perfect square — it looks exactly like a mouth (口)! Think of a robot with a square mouth saying 'ro-bo!'

letters.name: Wa (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'wa' in 'water'. ワ looks like a cup or a wide-open mouth — think of drinking water and going 'wa!' It's like a square with the bottom missing.

letters.name: Wo / O (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Pronounced like 'o' in modern Japanese. ヲ looks similar to フ (fu) with an extra horizontal line. Extremely rare — almost only used as the direct object particle in older texts. Words do not begin with ヲ in modern Japanese.

words.meaning: direct object marker (particle, rare in katakana)

letters.name: N (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: A standalone nasal 'n'. ン has two strokes pointing downward-left — think of a nose pointing down. Critical tip: ソ (so) strokes go down-right, ン (n) strokes go down-left. 'N' for 'nose' — pointing down-left toward your nose!

letters.name: Ga (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ga' in 'garden'. カ with dakuten — the sword blade now vibrates with power. Think of a garden gate swinging open.

letters.name: Gi (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'gi' in 'guitar'. キ with dakuten — the key now has a deeper ring. Think of a guitar string vibrating.

letters.name: Gu (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'goo' in 'good'. ク with dakuten — the corner now has a deeper hum. Think of something gooey and good.

letters.name: Ge (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ge' in 'get'. ケ with dakuten — the little flag now waves with a deeper breeze. Think of getting something and saying 'ge-t!' (get it?).

letters.name: Go (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'go' in English. コ with dakuten — the box now has a motor inside. Think of a go-kart racing — 'go go go!'

letters.name: Za (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'za' in 'pizza'. サ with dakuten — the profile face now buzzes. Think of a buzzing saw — 'za za za!'

letters.name: Ji (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'jee' in 'jeep'. シ with dakuten — the rain droplets now buzz with electricity. Think of a jeep splashing through puddles.

letters.name: Zu (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'zoo'. ス with dakuten — the running person now has a buzzing motor. Think of zooming past — 'zu!'

letters.name: Ze (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ze' in 'zebra'. セ with dakuten — the big grin now buzzes. Think of a zebra with a buzzing smile.

letters.name: Zo (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'zo' in 'zone'. ソ with dakuten — the sofa pillow now buzzes. Think of entering the zone — 'zo!'

letters.name: Da (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'da' in 'dance'. タ with dakuten — the taco dancer now wears heavy boots. Think of a deep drum beat — 'da!'

letters.name: Dji / Ji (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Pronounced the same as ジ (ji). ヂ is extremely rare — mainly used in some older loan transcriptions or as a stylistic choice. Like チ with dakuten.

letters.name: Dzu / Zu (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Pronounced the same as ズ (zu). ヅ is very rare — occasionally seen in older loanword transcriptions. Like ツ with dakuten.

letters.name: De (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'de' in 'desk'. テ with dakuten — the tennis net now has a deeper thrum. Think of a desk — a solid, sturdy surface.

letters.name: Do (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'do' in 'dough'. ト with dakuten — the toe now stomps. Think of a drum — 'do!' as the beat drops.

letters.name: Ba (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ba' in 'balloon'. ハ with dakuten — the number-8 shape now has a deeper hum. Think of a bass drum — 'ba ba ba!'

letters.name: Bi (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'bee'. ヒ with dakuten — the old key now buzzes like a bee. Think of a busy bee collecting honey — 'bi bi bi!'

letters.name: Bu (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'boo' in 'boot'. フ with dakuten — the corner puff now has a deep boom. Think of boots stomping — 'bu bu bu!'

letters.name: Be (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'be' in 'bed'. ヘ with dakuten — the mountain now has a deeper echo. Think of going to bed — 'be!' as you rest your head.

letters.name: Bo (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'bo' in 'boat'. ホ with dakuten — the holy cross now resonates deeply. Think of a boat horn — 'bo!' across the water.

letters.name: Pa (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'pa' in 'papa'. ハ with handakuten (little circle) — the number-8 gets a pop! Think of popcorn going 'pa!' in the pan.

letters.name: Pi (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'pea'. ヒ with handakuten — the key now pops! Think of popping peas — 'pi pi pi!'

letters.name: Pu (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'poo' in 'pool' but shorter. フ with handakuten — the corner puff now pops. Think of a swimming pool — 'pu!' as you splash in.

letters.name: Pe (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'pe' in 'pen'. ヘ with handakuten — the mountain now pops with crispness. Think of a pen clicking — 'pe!' as you start to write.

letters.name: Po (Katakana)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'po' in 'popcorn'. ホ with handakuten — the holy cross now pops! Think of popcorn — 'po po po!' as it bursts.

letters.name: Kya (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ャ on キ (ki) — like 'kya' as a surprised shriek! Think of a character in an anime going 'kyaaa!' when startled.

letters.name: Kyu (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ュ on キ (ki) — like 'cue' in English! Think of a pool cue striking the ball — 'kyu!' as you take your shot.

letters.name: Kyo (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ョ on キ (ki) — like 'kyo' as in 'Tokyo'! Think of the capital of Japan — one of the most famous place names in the world.

letters.name: Gya (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ャ on ギ (gi) — like 'gya' as a buzzy shriek! キャ with dakuten — the surprised 'kya' now has a deep growl.

letters.name: Gyu (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ュ on ギ (gi) — like 'gyu' as in squeezing tight! Think of hugging someone tight — 'gyu!'

letters.name: Gyo (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ョ on ギ (gi) — like 'gyo' as in 'gyoza'! Think of those delicious pan-fried dumplings — you'll never forget this sound.

letters.name: Sha (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ャ on シ (shi) — like 'sha' in 'shampoo'! Think of shampooing your hair — 'sha sha sha!'

letters.name: Shu (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ュ on シ (shi) — like 'shoe' in English! Think of putting on new shoes — 'shu!' as you slide your foot in.

letters.name: Sho (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ョ on シ (shi) — like 'show' in English! Think of a spectacular show — 'sho!' as the curtain rises.

letters.name: Ja (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ャ on ジ (ji) — like 'ja' in 'jazz'! シャ with dakuten. Think of a jazz band playing — 'ja ja ja!'

letters.name: Ju (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ュ on ジ (ji) — like 'joo' in 'juice'! シュ with dakuten. Think of squeezing fresh juice — 'ju!'

letters.name: Jo (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ョ on ジ (ji) — like 'jo' in 'joke'! ショ with dakuten. Think of a funny joke — 'jo jo jo!'

letters.name: Cha (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ャ on チ (chi) — like 'cha' in 'chocolate'! Think of a steaming cup of tea (ocha) — 'cha!' as you sip.

letters.name: Chu (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ュ on チ (chi) — like 'chew' in English! Think of chewing gum — 'chu chu!' as you chew.

letters.name: Cho (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ョ on チ (chi) — like 'cho' in 'chocolate'! Think of a chocolate bar — 'cho!' as you break off a piece.

letters.name: Nya (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ャ on ニ (ni) — like 'nya' as a cat's meow! The Japanese cat says 'nyaa' — and katakana often writes animal sounds.

letters.name: Nyu (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ュ on ニ (ni) — like 'new' in English! Think of something brand new — 'nyu!' as you unwrap it.

letters.name: Nyo (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ョ on ニ (ni) — like 'nyo' as a soft, strange little sound. Think of something mysterious — 'nyo!' as you discover a clue.

letters.name: Hya (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ャ on ヒ (hi) — like 'hya' as a breathy laugh! Think of a character laughing 'hya hya!' in a comic.

letters.name: Hyu (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ュ on ヒ (hi) — like 'hyoo' but breathier. Think of a cool wind whistling — 'hyu~' through the trees.

letters.name: Hyo (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ョ on ヒ (hi) — like 'hyo' as a surprised little sound! Think of seeing something unexpected — 'hyo!' with wide eyes.

letters.name: Bya (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ャ on ビ (bi) — like 'bya' with a buzzy voice. ヒャ with dakuten. Think of a bee going 'bya!' as it zooms past.

letters.name: Byu (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ュ on ビ (bi) — like 'byoo' with a buzzy voice. ヒュ with dakuten. Think of a viewpoint (byuu) — a way of seeing things differently.

letters.name: Byo (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ョ on ビ (bi) — like 'byo' as in hospital (byouin). ヒョ with dakuten. Think of going to the hospital for a checkup — 'byo!'

letters.name: Pya (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ャ on ピ (pi) — a popping 'pya'! ヒャ with handakuten. Think of a cartoon character popping out — 'pya!'

letters.name: Pyu (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ュ on ピ (pi) — a popping 'pyu'! ヒュ with handakuten. Think of a cork popping — 'pyu!' as it flies.

letters.name: Pyo (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ョ on ピ (pi) — a popping 'pyo'! ヒョ with handakuten. Think of popcorn going 'pyo pyo!'

letters.name: Mya (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ャ on ミ (mi) — like 'mya' as a soft meow. Think of a cat purring and going 'mya~' as it stretches.

letters.name: Myu (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ュ on ミ (mi) — like 'mew' as a kitten! Think of a musical (myuujikaru) — 'myu!' as the curtain rises.

letters.name: Myo (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ョ on ミ (mi) — like 'myo' as a mysterious sound. Think of something mysterious happening — 'myo!' as you discover the truth.

letters.name: Rya (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ャ on リ (ri) — like 'rya' with that Japanese tongue tap. Think of a brief, light snap — 'rya!'

letters.name: Ryu (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ュ on リ (ri) — like 'ryu' as in dragon (ryuu)! Think of a dragon soaring — 'ryu!' with flames.

letters.name: Ryo (Katakana Yōon)
letters.memoryTrick: Small ョ on リ (ri) — like 'ryo' as in travel (ryokou)! Think of setting off on a journey — 'ryo!' as you board the plane.
